name: creabb/nav-and-tab
title: Nav and Tab
description: Navigation available in Bootstrap share general markup and styles, from the base .nav class to the active and disabled states.

attributes.value: Extra small · no Bootstrap infix (default size)

attributes.label: Horizontal Align
attributes.help: Change the horizontal alignment of your nav with flexbox utilities. By default, navs are left-aligned, but you can easily change them to center or right aligned.

attributes.label: Vertical Align
attributes.help: Stack your navigation by changing the flex item direction with the .flex-column utility. Need to stack them on some viewports but not others? Use the responsive versions (e.g., .flex-sm-column).

attributes.label: Hide at this breakpoint
attributes.help: Hides this block at this breakpoint and restores it at the next visible one. While it is hidden, the alignment classes of this breakpoint are dropped as well.

attributes.label: Style
attributes.help: Bootstrap nav style, added as a class: nav-tabs draws the items as tabs, nav-pills as pills.

attributes.label: Fill & Justify
attributes.help: Force your .nav’s contents to extend the full available width one of two modifier classes. To proportionately fill all available space with your .nav-items, use .nav-fill. Notice that all horizontal space is occupied, but not every nav item has the same width.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
